name: sylvan-librarian-cloudflare
description: Sylvan Librarian, ported to run natively on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Durable Objects — free-plan deployable

scripts.build:wasm: cd engine/wasm && wasm-pack build --target bundler --release --out-dir pkg
scripts.build:wasm-import: cargo rustc --release -p sylvan-wasm-import --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -C link-arg=--max-memory=117440512 && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sylvan_wasm_import.wasm engine/wasm-import/pkg/
